title: Certify that no owned-helper relation subspace pays on the BIT word after #5421 (negative result, no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

**Before:** [#5421](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5421) (Ali Romman) owns nine helper relations on the reverse PR589 BIT word and leaves open whether a new relation space could give a further BIT gain. Target 6 of [#5428](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5428) proposes systematic relation-space selection for this.

**After:** on that word the question is closed exactly. Modulo #5421's nine relations, every owned-helper relation subspace V, of any dimension and in any combination, removes paid rank mass at most 7.5 · dim V. Each dimension costs one rank-8 target, so every subspace loses at least `8^t − 7.5 = 0.4424` raw moment per local call at C = 0.00347207. The bound holds for every C < 0.031. This is a negative result: no new κ and no new BIT saving.

**How.** Model: a paid job (MOVE of rank r > 0, or COPY rank 7) becomes free iff the GF(2) row of its moved value lies in V. Certificate: by the matroid union theorem, if m copies of the job-row multiset E' (each row repeated rank times) split into p linearly independent sets, then m·w(V) ≤ p·dim V for every V. Edmonds augmenting paths make the split exact. Frame and pivot legality are relaxed, so the bound also covers legal V.
- Calibration on the source word: E' splits into 8 sets, and the only tight subspaces are exactly #5421's nine (COPY H7 + MOVE H1).
- Modulo those nine: no tight row, and 2E' splits into 15 independent sets.
- Live controls: source 2E' into 15 sets fails; an extra rank-1 job on a COPY row breaks the 8-split. `test_verify.py` rejects a drifted input, a corrupted record rank, a dependent certificate part and a tampered RESULT.json.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-relation-subspaces
```

PASS locally on CPython 3.12 (Windows), about 30 s, standard library only; `check_research_commit.py` passes. Scope: the fixed PR589 operation order, helper inventory and job set; a changed chronology or BIT word is not covered. The second commit is the unchanged `docs/ci-verification.md` repair from #5420, needed while main's CI section is stale.

Task card `bit-helper-contract`, scope changed (see TASK.json). Credit: DreamingOfClouds (#589), eumemic (#555), Ali Romman (#5421, #5383), zxv (#5428).
